title: Table

ports.note: Every port a table can show, on every table, whatever its parameters say. The ports used to vary with an inputMode parameter -- reasoningInput, polygonInput and a table mode were three separate declarations of that -- so the port a connection needed might not exist on the node. Which renderer shows is now read from what is wired: src/core.ts#shownMode. The same change map_output took at 0.15.0.

ontology.note: TableView activity is implemented; broader table artifact contracts remain open. `emits` records what the module named in implementation.definition asserts, and this widget is defined in src/core.ts#TYPES, which asserts nothing — the fw:TableView facts are built in the execution case and are gated by validate:ontology-coupling, which holds at zero undeclared. Same shape as map_output 0.15.0.

changes.description: A figure can be left out of the write-up: "Not in the write-up" beside the four sections keeps it in Results, and the run writes no note for it and states it was left out (fw:figureInWriteUp false).

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. The self-description added in 0.6.0 is covered by tests/artifact-notes.test.mjs (13 unit checks, including that nothing machined numbers its own artifact or calls itself a caption, that an unnamed artifact is left unnamed rather than titled, and that a unit is stated once) and by tests/equation-notes.browser.mjs over the South London example on Chromium and WebKit. Both were mutation-checked by reintroducing the behaviour they forbid. 0.8.0: tests/table-output-standard.browser.mjs checks the panel and the totals claim applied in Configure…; tests/crosstab.test.mjs checks that a numeric key with one value leaves the table as rows. 0.10.1: tests/seven-one-seven.browser.mjs (responseWithinTarget shown as a column); Chromium. 0.10.2: tests/mers-from-scratch.browser.mjs (KDCA's 신고 주차 with Week of report beneath); Chromium. 0.11.0: Experiment 202, the publication render; the practitioner, 2026-11-14, of Hagelloch's daily-scan map: "we can leave it out of the notes". tests/write-up-shapes.test.mjs, tests/publication.test.mjs.
